info.name: Procest Leges API
info.description: API/contract coverage for the leges-heffingen feature (#67). Exercises the LegesController calculation endpoints and the LegesAdminController verordening-management endpoints against a live dossiq instance (localhost:8080, admin:admin). Happy paths plus 400 negative cases. Companion UI coverage lives in tests/e2e/leges-heffingen.spec.ts (Playwright). Auth is HTTP Basic + OCS-APIRequest at the collection level.

exec: pm.test('error names required parameters', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.match(/caseData and verordening are required/) })

item.name: Calculate — vast tariff returns total + breakdown

exec: pm.test('total equals the vast bedrag', function () { pm.expect(b.total).to.eql(250) })
pm.test('result carries audit fields', function () { pm.expect(b).to.have.property('calculatedBy'); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('calculatedAt'); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('version') })
pm.test('returns a recalculated total + breakdown', function () { pm.expect(b).to.have.property('total'); pm.expect(b.breakdown).to.be.an('array') })
pm.test('audit-trails the correction with a bumped version', function () { pm.expect(b).to.have.property('version') })

item.name: Admin — list verordeningen returns 200 + results array

exec: pm.test('200 OK (leges schemas configured)', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200) })
pm.test('response has a results array', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().results).to.be.an('array') })

item.name: Admin — import verordening with metaData persists concept (201 + tariefTabelId)

exec: pm.test('201 Created (write path persists, no TypeError)', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201) })
pm.test('returns a persisted tariefTabelId (real OR uuid)', function () { pm.expect(b).to.have.property('tariefTabelId'); pm.expect(b.tariefTabelId).to.be.a('string').and.to.have.length.above(0) })
pm.test('reports concept status and a written tarief', function () { pm.expect(b.status).to.eql('concept'); pm.expect(b.tarieven).to.be.at.least(1) })

item.name: Admin — import verordening without metaData returns 400

exec: pm.test('error names metaData', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error).to.match(/metaData is required/) })
